inputs.locator: Decision feature: complete UTC-day close strictly above exact TA-Lib-formula-compatible KAMA. For an efficiency window N, divide absolute close minus close N days ago by the sum of N absolute daily close changes, interpolate between fixed slow 2/31 and fast 2/3 constants, square the result, and recursively update KAMA from the prior KAMA. Use exact TA-Lib initialization and zero unstable period. Execute a changed target at the next H1 open.

Frozen variants and accounting: primary efficiency period 30 and rejection-only periods 20 and 40, with fast period 2, slow period 30 and close strictly above KAMA for all variants. Design is 2020-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and fair-reset annual folds 2020-2024. Candidate and buy-and-hold use equity one, zero-yield cash, no leverage or shorting, normal cost 10 bps fee plus 5 bps adverse slippage each side and stress cost 20 plus 10 bps.

Frozen all-pass gates: positive normal and stress returns; Design drawdown at most 95 percent of buy-and-hold and Calmar at least buy-and-hold; Validation drawdown at most 90 percent, upside capture at least 60 percent, Calmar at least buy-and-hold, 2 to 250 position changes, stress drawdown at most normal plus 3pp, positive terminal-liquidation return and cost at most 1pp; both neighbors positive under both costs with non-worse drawdown, at least 75 percent Calmar and 50 percent upside capture; annual normal and stress positive at least 4/5, drawdown non-worse 4/5, Calmar breadth 3/5, upside breadth 4/5, top-year and top-episode contribution at most 60 percent, P90 and terminal holding at most 17520 hours.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen TA-Lib-formula-compatible KAMA adaptive-trend BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash policy on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the official-default KAMA30 primary with rejection-only KAMA20 and KAMA40 under matched full-capital buy-and-hold, normal costs and stress costs. Freeze a historical candidate only if every Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, drawdown, holding and terminal-inventory gate passes; otherwise permanently close the exact family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not OOS or Trading authorization.

performance_case.causal_mechanism: KAMA changes its recursive smoothing coefficient with the ratio of net complete-day displacement to cumulative absolute complete-day movement, reacting faster to directionally efficient paths and slower to choppy paths before the next-open decision.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 historical Design and Validation decision for close strictly above exact TA-Lib-formula-compatible KAMA20, KAMA30 and KAMA40 with KAMA30 primary. It cannot inspect post-2024 data, tune any formula or gate, substitute a neighbor, create Trading behavior, activate a strategy or open OOS unless every frozen gate passes.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The policy is valuable only if efficiency-adaptive smoothing exits enough noisy or adverse paths to meet strict drawdown and Calmar gates without sacrificing required upside, hiding losses in terminal inventory or concentrating gains in one year or episode.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One frozen low-cost screen either produces a historical candidate for independent OOS or closes the exact KAMA20/30/40 family before optimization or runtime work consumes capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The primary completed-day close-above-KAMA30 state improves after-cost risk-adjusted performance versus matched full-capital buy-and-hold in both Design and historical Validation, with stable KAMA20 and KAMA40 neighbors and broad annual support.

decision_time.availability_rule: All daily closes through completed day D and the prior efficiency-window history are known before the next H1 open; no incomplete day or later bar is used.

Read only the listed files, task messages and exact sealed TSV. Do not inspect another research artifact, current server state, post-2024 bar, forward outcome or OOS.

Return BTC_DAILY_KAMA30_HISTORICAL_CANDIDATE_FROZEN_REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED only if every frozen primary and neighbor gate passes; valid paired evidence otherwise returns BTC_DAILY_KAMA30_FAMILY_CLOSE without tuning.
Return BTC_DAILY_KAMA30_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT for any input, data, temporal, initialization, arithmetic, accounting or required-field failure. Do not partially classify or request permission.
